purpose: One record per licence class present in public GLB metadata (classes from src/domains/body-exposure/engine/attributionCoverage.ts). Each record names the primary source that was actually fetched, when, and the SHA-256 of the bytes read. A record proves the licence TEXT was read at its primary source; it does not prove that Panacea's use is legally cleared, and no record may claim that.

retrieval.method: curl -sSL with a descriptive user agent; HTTP status and SHA-256 of the response body recorded; visible text checked for the licence or publication title
